Brings requirements discovery, system dependencies and delivery judgment together, with production tools and integrations alongside independent AI-platform architecture.

chunks.title: Latitude and OptiPlex support
chunks.decision: Kept the client’s hardware problem central to diagnosis rather than optimizing the call around duration.
process: Investigate symptoms with the client.
Explain the hardware issue and next steps clearly.
chunks.outcome: Worked within the Gloves Off support model, aiming to resolve the issue on the first call.
chunks.resumeText: Supported Latitude laptops and OptiPlex desktops on Dell’s Gloves Off team, working through hardware diagnosis with clients and explaining the next steps clearly.
qualificationNotes: No numerical first-call resolution rate is established.

chunks.title: Small Business Server swing migrations
chunks.decision: Separated combined service roles as customers outgrew Small Business Server, keeping identity, data and email dependencies visible.
process: Identify the combined Exchange and Active Directory dependencies.
Use a repeatable swing-migration process into separated infrastructure.
Preserve data and email through the transition.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Developed the migration approach alongside practical server and network project work.
chunks.outcome: Developed a reusable migration process; no measured success rate is established.
chunks.resumeText: Developed a repeatable Small Business Server swing-migration process, separating infrastructure roles while accounting for data, email and identity dependencies.
qualificationNotes: No audited preservation guarantee or exact project date is asserted.

chunks.title: Headquarters infrastructure and move
chunks.period: Building completed 2012; occupancy January 2013; exact IT move date unconfirmed
chunks.decision: Designed for an occupied headquarters, connecting cooling and resilient power to networking, AV and security.
process: Work through infrastructure requirements from planning.
Account for physical and operational dependencies during the build.
Carry the technical plan through the move and transition.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Technical design contribution connected the infrastructure plan with the building’s practical operation.
chunks.outcome: Technical delivery through a planned move and collaborative recovery; business running by Monday in Josh’s account.

qualificationNotes: No budget or quantified reliability claim.
The broader bare-metal blade centre to ESXi work has no established exact date.

chunks.title: Broker policy inquiry
chunks.decision: Treated an inquiry as both a broker workflow and a data contract, preserving the meaning of policy, billing and claims information.
process: Define inquiry mockups and mappings.
Trace broker SOAP/XML requests and diagnose mismatches.
Test returned values and downloadable documents against the broker workflow.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Connected broker-management vendor requests to proprietary backend information.
chunks.outcome: Contributed inquiry workflows with downloadable policy, billing and claims PDFs.
chunks.resumeText: Connected broker inquiry workflows to backend policy, billing and claims information through mockups, field/value mappings, SOAP/XML request diagnosis and integration testing; REST was used in the later backend.
qualificationNotes: Exact completion date is not established.

chunks.title: Commercial quoting and broker integration
chunks.decision: Made risk information and insurance meaning explicit across broker inputs, backend fields and rule decisions.
process: Map CSIO/ACORD payload fields, data and values to proprietary backend fields.
Specify fields, UI stages and missing risk information with vendor teams.
Implement related rating/underwriting rules and test broker requests.
chunks.technicalGuidance: Directed UI/specification changes; vendor teams performed commercial quoting development.
chunks.outcome: Connected requirements, mappings and hands-on rules implementation across residential, auto, farm and commercial workflows.
chunks.resumeText: Designed and implemented P&C rating and underwriting rules, mapped CSIO/ACORD broker payloads to proprietary backend fields, and directed UI/specification changes so commercial quoting collected the required risk information.
qualificationNotes: Responsibility does not imply a formal Architect job title.
Vendor teams performed commercial quoting development.
AL3 and eDocs familiarity is supported; hands-on JSON standards experience is not claimed.

chunks.title: Auto and residential new-business integration

Implement rating/underwriting validation.
Help define correction, referral or bind messages for the broker portal.

chunks.resumeText: Implemented rating and underwriting rules and helped design broker-portal messages for correction, referral or binding, with validation that distinguished new business, renewals and endorsements.

chunks.title: Renewal eligibility and exception routing

Implement rating/underwriting classification for each business context.
Refer exceptions for human review.

Repeatable validation, XML batch preparation and error reconciliation

chunks.title: LOWKEY
chunks.decision: Connected local speech decoding to native Windows input and an Android keyboard.
process: Capture audio with AudioWorklet and process phrases in a dedicated Rust worker with Silero detection.
Run cached sherpa-onnx/Parakeet models locally.
Connect the result to native input and a Kotlin Android IME; support optional local correction/dictionaries and fallback.
chunks.outcome: Implemented local decoding workflows; no trustworthy numerical speed benchmark exists.
chunks.resumeText: Built local speech-to-input workflows in LOWKEY using React/TypeScript, Rust/Tauri 2 and sherpa-onnx/Parakeet, with AudioWorklet capture, phrase detection and a Kotlin Android keyboard.
qualificationNotes: Independent project, not employer experience.
No universal device support, NPU, speed or absolute-security claim.
Local decoding/source review is not a network audit.
Archived at Josh’s explicit request; excluded from current resume selections.
